evidence: "T = E + 6"; gpt-oss-120b builds adjacency/bit masks for triangle detection; glm-5 iterates over edges and neighbor intersections; deepseek-v4-flash directly checks whether a, b, c form a triangle
affordance_in_statement: For any group of three workers, we define two metrics based on the incident files: T: The sum of the individual incident file counts for each of the three workers. E: The number of incident files that list exactly one worker from this core group of three (and one worker outside this core group). You must find a group of exactly three distinct workers such that T = E + 6.
removal_suggestion: Re-present the condition through an equivalent formulation that does not expose the cancellation between internal and external incidences; for example, define the required quantity using separately specified internal-edge and boundary-edge contributions rather than presenting T and E as degree and crossing counts. This preserves the intended condition but removes the immediate T-E=2|internal edges| observation.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses the incidence identity T = E + 2 times the number of files with both endpoints in the chosen triple, so the required value 6 means all three internal pairs are present.

common_affordance: The equation T = E + 6, together with the definitions of T as total incidence and E as the boundary incidence, algebraically forces the chosen three workers to induce exactly three internal files—a triangle.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Its approach incurs excessive work and data-structure overhead, leading to time-limit exceeded rather than exploiting the triangle reduction efficiently.

recommended_edit: Replace the direct T/E presentation with an equivalent, less locally transparent definition of the required score, distributing the internal-pair contribution across separately described record categories so that solving requires deriving the incidence identity instead of immediately recognizing triangle detection.
regression_risk: A purely wording-based obfuscation may not defeat gpt-oss-120b or glm-5 if they independently derive the incidence identity; deepseek-v4-flash may still succeed if the input remains an ordinary undirected graph and the intended condition remains triangle existence.
